result.topic_en: Calculations on a quartic surface of the form (quadratic form)^2 + 4(x+y+z)xyz = 0, its coefficient determinants, and identities among quantities p, q, r such as $(-p+q+r)^2-4qr=(p-q+r)^2-4pr$ related to $\sqrt p+\sqrt q+\sqrt r=0$, with small 0/1 sign tables in the upper right.

$f=p+q+r\qquad qr=(f-p-q)q=(\frac{f}{2}-q)^2+(\frac{f}{2})^2-pq$
$f-2q=p-q+r$
$f^2-4pq=(f-2q)^2+4qr$

$(-p+q+r)^2-4qr=(p-q+r)^2-4pr=(p+q-r)^2-4pq$

methods.what: Quartic surface written as square of a ternary quadratic form plus a cubic-times-linear term
Shifted symmetric coefficient matrix and expansion of its determinant
Symmetric identity for p,q,r, i.e. the rationalized form of $\sqrt p+\sqrt q+\sqrt r=0$
